articles.summary: Vail Resorts CEO Rob Katz took the stage earlier this summer at Denver’s Outside Summit, sharing his perspective on the future of skiing and snowboarding—and why the industry’s next chapter centers on elevating the guest experience.
articles.title: Vail Resorts CEO Rob Katz Shares Vision for the Future of Skiing at Outside Summit

articles.summary: Heavenly Mountain Resort, Keep Tahoe Blue, and Arts and Culture El Dorado are launching a Gondola art activation on June 17 to promote sustainable, car-free travel around Lake Tahoe.
articles.title: Heavenly Mountain Resort, Keep Tahoe Blue, Arts and Culture El Dorado Unveil Gondola Art Activation to Inspire Sustainable Transportation at Lake Tahoe
